'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Belarusian involvement in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****Thousands of [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian troops]] enter [[Belarus]] by the "trainload" as [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] warns [[G7]] nations that [[Russia]] is planning on launching another offensive against [[Kyiv]] with direct Belarusian involvement. The troop movements come a day after [[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] accused [[Ukraine]] of planning to launch an attack on the country. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-news-russia-war-latest-b2200068.html?page=4#post-874349 (''The Independent'')]
***[[Lviv]] experiences a major [[power outage]] after a Russian missile strike damages "critical infrastructure". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-strike-ukraines-lviv-hits-power-supply-mayor-says-2022-10-11/ (Reuters)]
***[[Russia]] adds [[Meta Platforms]], the parent company of [[Instagram]] and [[Facebook]], to its list of "terrorists and extremists" for tolerating [[Russophobia]] and allowing calls to violence against Russians. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/11/russia-adds-meta-to-list-of-terrorist-and-extremist-groups (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Ethnic violence in South Sudan]]
**The UN [[Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs]] says that renewed fighting between [[tribe]]s has [[internally displaced person|displaced]] more than 8,000 [[civilian]]s in [[South Sudan]]. [https://english.news.cn/20221011/0f9d1ae5219041ba99af770008787809/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**An [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldier]] is killed by two [[Lions' Den (militant group)|Lions' Den]] gunmen near the [[Israeli settlement]] of [[Shavei Shomron]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/11/palestinian-fighters-kill-israeli-soldier-in-occupied-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Hurricane Julia (2022)|Hurricane Julia]]
**Fourteen people in [[Guatemala]] and ten in [[El Salvador]] are killed as Hurricane Julia causes torrential rain in both countries. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/tropical-storm-julia-drenches-central-america-with-rainfall/ (Associated Press via CBS News)]
*Ten people are killed and 4 others are injured after a fire broke out in [[Esigodini]], [[Matabeleland South Province]], [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://newsghana.com.gh/ten-zimbabwean-farm-workers-killed-in-veld-fire/ (Xinhua via NewsGhana)]
*At least 32 people are injured after a carbon monoxide leak is discovered in a care home in [[Allentown, Pennsylvania|Allentown]], [[Pennsylvania]], United States. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/11/us/allentown-daycare-happy-smiles-carbon-monoxide/index.html (CNN)]
'''International relations'''
*[[Israeli–Lebanese maritime border dispute]]
**It is announced that [[Israel]] and [[Lebanon]] have agreed to a United States-brokered agreement that will allow both countries to exploit [[gas field]]s in the eastern [[Mediterranean Sea]], thereby ending decades of [[maritime border]] disputes between the two nations. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/israel-and-lebanon-reach-historic-agreement-on-maritime-borders/ar-AA12Po7o (''The Washington Post'' via MSN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Los Angeles City Council controversy]]
**A meeting of the [[Los Angeles City Council]] is disrupted by protesters calling for the [[resignation]]s of council members after then-president [[Nury Martinez]] was heard on a leaked audio recording making racist remarks and denigrating colleagues. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2022-10-11/nury-martinez-city-council-seat-audio-leak (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[2022 Lesotho general election]]
**[[Revolution for Prosperity]] party leader [[Sam Matekane]] announces that his party has formed a majority coalition with the [[Alliance of Democrats (Lesotho)|Alliance of Democrats]] and the [[Movement for Economic Change]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/lesothos-rfp-party-forms-coalition-government-with-other-opposition-after-2022-10-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Same-sex marriage in Mexico]]
**The Federal [[State of Mexico]] legalizes [[same-sex marriage]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-caribbean-legislature-gay-rights-city-e4f9c4f820f9e0960dbcefb74ac0f17c (Associated Press)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Double Asteroid Redirection Test]]
**[[NASA]] says that its DART [[spacecraft]] has successfully altered the orbit of the {{conv|520|ft|m}} [[asteroid]] [[Dimorphos]] by around 32 minutes in a demonstration of [[asteroid impact avoidance]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-63221577 (BBC News)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/science/nasa-dart-mission-successful-orbit-1.6612806 (Associated Press via CBC)]
